adjudicator_note: Adjudication settles values; it is not a second measurement. One decision-maker resolves each conflict, so there is one sheet and one gold standard. Who that was is recorded above and must be stated in the manuscript: a conflict settled by one of the two annotators is not equivalent to one settled by a third party.
note: Gold field values authored from the transcript, model-independent. Segments unresolved on any field are excluded, not defaulted. Accuracy computed against this file is conditional on the adjudicated subset.
